help.how_to_play:
❇️ *How to Play Bingo*

**Getting Started:**
1. Click "❇️ Open Bingo" to open the Bingo web app.
2. You will receive a unique 5x5 Bingo card (numbers 1–75).
3. A new number is drawn every 3–5 seconds.

**Marking Numbers:**
• Tap the number on your card if it matches the drawn ball.
• Numbers are automatically checked, but you can tap to confirm.

**Winning:**
• Complete a row, column, diagonal, or the four corners (depending on the game mode).
• When you win, click the "BINGO!" button immediately.
• The server verifies your win; if valid, you receive the prize.

**Important:**
• You can play multiple rounds.
• Your progress is saved even if you disconnect; just reopen the game.
help.payouts:
🤑 *Payouts & Prizes*

**Prize Pool:**
• The prize pool accumulates from entry fees or operator funds.
• A fixed commission (e.g., 3%) is deducted from each round.
• The remaining amount is paid to the winner(s).

**Payout Calculation:**
• Standard Bingo: the first valid Bingo wins the whole pool.
• Pattern games: multiple winners share the pool equally.

**Payout Speed:**
• Winnings are credited to your balance instantly after validation.
• You can withdraw via the bot using available methods.

**Minimum Withdrawal:**
• Check the bot's balance section for current limits.
help.referral:
👥 *Referral Program*

**How it Works:**
• Share your unique referral link with friends.
• When they join and play, you earn commission.

**Commission Structure:**
• Level 1 (direct referrals): 10% of their net gaming fees.
• Level 2: 5% of their referrals' gaming fees.
• Level 3: 2% of further referrals.

**Tracking:**
• Use /settings to see your referral stats.
• Your link: `https://t.me/ethio_bingoobot?start=ref_YOURCODE`

**Tip:** Share your link on social media, forums, or with friends to maximize earnings!
help.technical:
📡 *Technical Requirements*

**For Best Experience:**
• Stable internet connection (3G/4G/Wi-Fi).
• Updated browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, or Telegram's built-in browser).
• Enable JavaScript.

**If You Disconnect:**
• The game remembers your card and marked numbers.
• Just reopen the game – you will rejoin the current round.
• If you miss a few numbers, you can still win (but it's harder).

**Data Usage:**
• Minimal; approximately 10–20 MB per hour of play.
help.fairness:
🔒 *Game Fairness & Security*

**Provably Fair:**
• All ball draws are pre-shuffled using cryptographic hashing (HMAC-SHA256).
• After each round, you can verify the result with the server's secret.

**Anti-Cheat Measures:**
• All win checks are performed server-side.
• Your card is stored securely; you cannot modify it.
• If you claim BINGO, the server validates your card against drawn numbers.

**Random Card Generation:**
• Cards follow standard Bingo distributions (e.g., column 1: 1-15, etc.).
• Every card has equal statistical chance of winning.

**Security:**
• Your balance and personal data are encrypted.
• Session tokens expire regularly.
